events.headline: NORTH KOREA FIRES BALLISTIC MISSILE TOWARDS THE SEA, SOUTH KOREA SAYS
events.detail: A ballistic missile fired from the North Korean port city of Wonsan flies more than 700km, South Korea's military says.
